Why This Role? Why Now?

Customer experience is transforming through AI-driven innovation. At Zendesk, we don’t just embrace this change — we lead it. This role transcends technical deployment; it is about owning the strategic AI roadmap, maximizing business impact, and builds executive partnerships from day one so AI initiatives start strong and scale predictably.

Mission

You will own end-to-end delivery of customers’ AI roadmaps: translating product capabilities into clear business strategies, defining a long-term AI vision, aligning internal and external teams, and driving execution from initial adoption through sustained expansion. Your success is measured by high customer satisfaction, increased automated resolution usage, and improved retention—while orchestrating the right mix of product, services, and partner resources. You will lead structured discovery and success-planning engagements that create measurable playbooks and milestones early in the lifecycle.

Overarching Objective For The Role

Accelerate customers’ time‑to‑value by driving adoption and operational excellence for Zendesk AI solutions, ensuring customers realize measurable business impact from initial deployment through scale
Own customers’ multi‑year AI roadmap and execute cross‑functional delivery—aligning Product, Services, Sales, and Partners to scale safe, sustainable AI programs
Deliver quantifiable commercial outcomes—protect renewals, grow account expansion, and translate AI adoption into predictable revenue and retention improvements

How You’ll Make An Impact

Strategic Responsibilities

Full Ownership of AI Roadmap Delivery: Lead the design, planning, and execution of comprehensive AI adoption and expansion roadmaps for key customers, ensuring alignment to their broader business goals and customer success vision.
Design Authority: Serve as the design authority for customers’ AI deployments — lead solution design reviews, ensure deployments align with the latest best practices and collaborate with Professional Services on integration and configuration guidance. For complex agent implementations, coordinate troubleshooting and technical escalations with Professional Services, Product and Engineering to resolve blockers quickly.

Consultation & Communication: Strong stakeholder engagement skills—whether customer executives or internal teams—to advance AI adoption and sustain strategic partnerships.

Demonstrated experience in using adoption and health analytics to forecast churn and expansion; surface early risk signals and recommended mitigations to secure retention and growth.

jobs.description:
ABOUT THE SIGNATURE BRAND:

Honia's own journey is what makes this programme so compelling. She built her personal brand from ground up, teaching herself what actually works through trial and error after closing down her beauty salon so she could stop trading her time for money and earn an online income. Today she's built a personal brand with over 1 Million total followers, and a thriving coaching business helping thousands of other women do the same.

The Signature Brand is built for business owners, mentors, coaches and aspiring creators ready to build and monetise a personal brand. Health and fitness coaches, beauty business owners, finance and career mentors, real estate agents, and ambitious women from many other walks of life make up a large part of our community, alongside driven beginners just getting started with building a personal brand. What they all share is a genuine drive to turn their skills, expertise, passions or experiences into content that drives online income. 

Members join a genuinely supportive, high-energy community built around real progress: 12+ live coaching sessions across a 4-week programme, including weekly calls directly with Honia and sessions from her wider coaching team, a private Discord for daily support and feedback, live content audit sessions, a 6-module course covering everything from content creation to monetisation, along with custom AI Tools to support their journey. 

As the community continues to grow, we're bringing on a dedicated Customer Success Manager to sit right at the heart of it, making sure every member gets the guidance, structure and support they need to get real results.

Learn more: https://event.honiakader.com/c/cohort-5-early-bird  

THE ROLE:

Think of this role as the engine room of The Signature Brand experience. It is the Customer Success Manager who makes sure the community runs properly every single day: questions get answered quickly, members' content gets reviewed thoroughly, and ones who go quiet are followed up with before they fall off track. They are the key player in ensuring that every student gets the most out of the experience.

The Customer Success Manager will also become a key part of the coaching team, and they should bring their own expertise and experience to the programme through live teaching sessions and Q&A’s. 

This role is ideal for someone who wants to build a career in business consultation, community management, or coaching operations within the online education and creator space. You do not need years of consulting experience, but you do need to be organised, personable, and genuinely interested in helping aspiring creators, business owners, mentors and coaches build and monetise a personal brand.

You should have a real working knowledge of content strategy, personal branding and monetisation through courses and digital products, and you will be trusted to give members practical, first-line guidance in these areas.

You will work closely with Honia and her coaching team, along with Genflow's wider marketing and operations team to ensure maximum success of the programme and strategic growth of the business. 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Consultative Support for Members

Give members practical, first-line advice on content, personal branding and monetisation, including how to sell through a course, digital product, or coaching - one of the most common areas of support desired by members 
Review members content, and give clear, specific, constructive feedback
Ensure members are on track with the programme education by guiding them through the module content, AI Tools and resources
Build in-depth knowledge of the 6-module curriculum alongside Honia’s wider teaching principles, so advice stays consistent with what The Signature Brand teaches.
Take ownership of member communications, while knowing when is appropriate to pass on a question to Honia or another member of the team

Day-to-Day Discord Community Management

Welcome new members, onboard them onto the programme, and ensure they fully understand the process when they join
Be the go-to, active presence in the Discord every working day, ensuring every student feels seen and heard, and gets their questions answered. 
Take ownership of keeping the community engaged and positive, through bringing a warm, supportive, and enthusiastic presence. 
Encourage and lead the way on sharing and celebrating all member wins 
Moderate channels and escalate anything that needs input from Honia, another coach, or customer services
Spot recurring questions or problems and feed patterns back to the wider team to help continue to develop the programme experience 

Operational Management

Own the operational onboarding of students at the start of new cohorts. Including monitoring all sign-ups, tracking payments, ensuring everyone joins the Discord community and has access to the platform, and is on the email list for live call links. 
Own the calendar: create, post and manage links and reminders for coaching sessions, content audits and events, ensuring all members have easy access to sessions
Track delivery. Students often win bonuses or upgrade to additional services, and it will be your responsibility to track these, ensuring all members receive their promised deliverables.
Track live session attendance, engagement, and common questions or sticking points.
Follow up directly with members who go quiet or don’t engage in the community or live sessions.
Flag missed payments to the customer support team.
Keep records of member progress and flag at-risk members early.
Monitor and record general member sentiment around satisfaction with the program and feed back constructive ideas for improvement to the wider team 
Keep on top of member success stories, progress, growth metrics, and all positive feedback. Seeking strong testimonials and reviews for use in future marketing 

GENERAL REQUIREMENTS:

Able to work independently and show up in the community consistently and attentively every working day
Remote, but able to cross over with our UK and UAE teams for a minimum of 5 hours a day
Warm, clear communicator who builds trust and rapport quickly
Meticulously organised and detail-oriented
Genuinely interested in personal branding, content, coaching and business monetisation
Comfortable on camera and confident public speaking while teaching live classes 
Can proactively propose improvements, innovations, and solutions to problems

SKILLS & EXPERIENCE:

Understanding of personal branding fundamentals: content creation, scripting and messaging, social media growth strategy, and monetisation through coaching, courses or digital products (essential)
Experience in account management, customer success, community management or coaching operations
Discord or online community moderation experience (strong plus)
Strong written communication skills 
Able to juggle multiple moving parts without letting anything slip

Bonus: experience working with trainers, mentors, coaches, or service-based business owners
Bonus: experience in creating content yourself and/or managing others’ social media accounts
Bonus: experience in a coaching programme or membership as a coordinator, moderator or support role

PLEASE NOTE:
This is a full time, 40 hour/ week role. Our teams are based across the UK and Dubai, so you will need to be able to work hours that overlap these two time zones.

Join us to transform the way the world works.

Job Description

The role is open to Sunnyvale or San Francisco.

At LinkedIn, our approach to flexible work is centered on trust and optimized for culture, connection, clarity, and the evolving needs of our business. The work location of this role is hybrid, meaning it will be performed both from home and from a LinkedIn office on select days, as determined by the business needs of the team.

The Customer Success Manager (CSM) partners closely with their assigned sales partners to ensure LinkedIn Customers achieve a significant return on investment and drive business success with their LinkedIn investment.​ 

As a CSM you will be tasked with: ​ 

Serving as a Customer Champion and Advocate​ 

Helping Customers realize value from their investment​ 

Partnering on customer retention and expansion. 

The CSM will partner with various stakeholders within assigned customers, to ensure effective user and product onboarding and engagement on LinkedIn products and solutions. 

 Responsibilities:

Advance personal journey with Diversity, Inclusion, and Belonging as this is a top priority for LinkedIn and many of its customers.

Partner with sales counterparts on prioritized customers to drive overall customer adoption, enhance customer success, and mitigate customer churn risk​.

Act as a trusted advisor to the end users and their management to drive product adoption and ensure they leverage the solution to achieve agreed upon operational priorities, leading to full business value​.

Utilize client usage and industry metrics to derive insights and use these to drive greater customer engagement and adoption.

Analyze current customer engagement metrics and leverage the Learning Center to provide new and ongoing product education options. 

Track and record customer activity in a timely manner in systems of record, i.e., Dynamics​.

Identify churn risk and maintain healthy customer engagement levels by identifying low utilization and providing solutions to further drive customer success​.

Maintain a deep understanding of LinkedIn products to effectively guide customers on best practice.

Interpret customer insights to drive change in product and act as voice of customer to LinkedIn Product teams​ ​ 

Expedite technical and purchase-related escalations 

Minimum travel may be required

Welcome to the Agentic Commerce Era

At Commerce, our mission is to empower businesses to innovate, grow, and thrive with our open, AI-driven commerce ecosystem. As the parent company of BigCommerce, Feedonomics, and Makeswift, we connect the tools and systems that power growth, enabling businesses to unlock the full potential of their data, deliver seamless and personalized experiences across every channel, and adapt swiftly to an ever-changing market. We believe in harnessing AI responsibly to unlock new possibilities, and we’re looking for individuals who use it intentionally to solve problems, accelerate outcomes, and expand what’s possible in their role. Our purpose is to help businesses confidently solve complex commerce challenges so they can build smarter, adapt faster, and grow on their own terms. If you want to be part of a team of bold builders, sharp thinkers, and technical trailblazers who shape the future of commerce, this is the place for you.

At Commerce, we're helping merchants of all sizes sell more and grow faster through our leading open SaaS ecommerce platform. We're passionate about building exceptional customer experiences while fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous growth.

We're looking for an experienced Manager, Customer Success Management, to lead a high-performing team responsible for driving customer retention, adoption, expansion, and long-term customer value.

If you're passionate about developing people, leveraging data to drive business outcomes, and building scalable Customer Success organizations, we'd love to meet you.

What You'll Do

As a Customer Success leader, you'll own the performance and development of a team responsible for delivering measurable customer and commercial outcomes.

Lead & Develop a High-Performing Team

Coach, mentor, and develop Customer Success Managers across multiple customer segments
Create a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement
Drive performance through regular coaching, career development, and performance management
Ensure team capacity, priorities, and customer coverage align with business objectives

Drive Business Performance

Own team performance against Net Revenue Retention (NRR) and key business metrics
Lead forecasting for renewals, churn risk, expansion opportunities, and portfolio health
Monitor dashboards and KPIs to identify trends, risks, and opportunities
Present business performance, forecasts, and recommendations to senior leadership

Deliver Outstanding Customer Outcomes

Lead strategies across the entire customer lifecycle—from onboarding through renewal and expansion
Ensure customers achieve measurable business value through strategic Success Plans
Improve adoption, engagement, advocacy, and long-term retention
Drive consistency across customer engagement and lifecycle best practices

Manage Risk & Escalations

Proactively identify customer and commercial risk
Lead executive-level customer escalations and complex renewal situations
Implement strategies that reduce churn and improve renewal outcomes
Use customer health data and insights to improve predictability

Partner Across the Business

Collaborate with Sales, Product, Support, Marketing, Operations, and Executive Leadership
Act as the Voice of the Customer by translating feedback into product and operational Improvements
Lead initiatives that improve scalability, operational excellence, and customer experience

Success Looks Like

You'll Be Measured On

Net Revenue Retention (NRR)
Renewal performance
Customer growth and expansion
Forecast accuracy
Customer engagement and adoption
Churn reduction
Customer health improvements
Team productivity and development
OKR achievement

Who You Are

6–10 years of experience in Customer Success, Strategic Account Management, SaaS, Ecommerce, Consulting, or related customer-facing commercial roles
3+ years leading and developing Customer Success or customer-facing teams
Proven success improving NRR, renewals, customer retention, expansion, and adoption
Experience managing forecasting, business reviews, reporting, and operational performance
Strong understanding of Customer Success operating models, customer lifecycle management, segmentation, and health scoring
Experience partnering cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Support, Finance, and Executive
Strong analytical, strategic, and communication skills
Experience leading complex customer escalations and balancing customer advocacy with business priorities

Preferred

Experience with Gainsight, Salesforce, and Tableau
Background in SaaS, ecommerce, or subscription-based businesses
Familiarity with AI productivity tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, or NotebookLM
Experience using data and analytics to improve customer outcomes and operational performance

What Makes You Successful

We're looking for someone who is:

A people-first leader who enjoys coaching and developing talent
Commercially minded with strong business acumen
Data-driven and comfortable making decisions from insights
Customer obsessed while balancing business priorities
Operationally excellent with a bias toward execution
Comfortable navigating ambiguity and leading through change
Passionate about building scalable Customer Success organizations

Why Commerce?

At Commerce, you'll have the opportunity to shape the future of Customer Success while working alongside talented teammates who are passionate about helping merchants succeed. We invest in our people, embrace innovation, and believe great customer experiences start with empowered teams.

If you're excited about leading teams, driving customer outcomes, and making a measurable business impact, we'd love to hear from you.

Work Where You Thrive

For candidates based in the Austin or Atlanta metro area, the position follows a hybrid work model with three days per week in the office, balancing focused individual work with meaningful in-person collaboration.

Apply today and help us build the future of commerce.

Note - Applications for this role will be reviewed on an ongoing basis. Qualified candidates may be contacted when a position that matches their experience becomes available.

($106,010.00 - $152,388.00)
